item.title: A ground trace from above finds the arch, not the ground
item.description: Our generated path climbed over ruined arches. One downward trace returns whatever hangs over the point. The fix traces the whole column and chooses.

item.title: A plugin's DefaultGame.ini does not change the project's cook list. Config/Game.ini does.
item.description: Our plugin shipped a cook list that Unreal never read. The file name decides whether plugin config changes the host project.

item.title: SpawnActor ignores your location when the actor has no root component
item.description: A tower appeared inside the wall ring at every Play and sank away. The cause was one SpawnActor call whose location was silently discarded.

item.title: UE 5.5+: CellSize and AgentMaxStepHeight in the ini do nothing
item.description: The flat RecastNavMesh ini keys are deprecated and silently ignored. Our wall stairs had navmesh holes until we set NavMeshResolutionParams instead.
